case.summary: Case HHG-008 was opened on 2016-12-20 following a customer report from customer C13171 stating they never made the $55.68 online transaction 3558054 on card C13171-K2. Graph analysis and the closed-case classifier identified a card_not_present_new_device pattern with a fraud probability of 0.99 and a fraud verdict across 3 affected transactions totaling $166.97 (3557979, 3557987, 3558054). Because probability is 0.99 with multiple independent signals and exposure under $2,500 under §2, R1 was not triggered, and recommended actions include BLOCK_CARD on route L1 and CREATE_CASE on route auto under §3a. The case was closed as fraud under §6.
